roles.description:
• Developed a simple, user-friendly, and lightweight dashboard platform for users across Indonesia, ensuring a seamless experience even in areas with slow or unstable internet access.
• Observed resource usage, calculated efficiencies, and provided recommendations to ensure resource utilization remained at ~60%, optimizing cost savings for infrastructure.
• Boosted test coverage from 41% to 91%, significantly enhancing code quality and reliability.
• Implement integration test and visual test.
• Documenting technical guides for project handover.

• Assigned as the front end developer of their new project, which was initiated to build a marketplace ecosystem, where retailers, distributors, and manufactures can meet and collaborate to develop their business.
• Led a team and communicated with the Gobiz (a super app from Gojek for merchants) team regarding our product catalog PWA embedded in Gobiz app.

• Developed features, implement A/B Test, and revamped UI components in Tjetak Market (a one stop solution marketplace for printing and packaging needs).
• Improved the UI of Tjetak Plus (a marketplace with specific focus to B2B).
• Improved the SEO of the Tjetak Market by completing the meta title, description, keywords, etc. of Tjetak product and category pages based on the recommendation of Tjetak SEO Consultant.
• Deployed the application to staging and production servers in Google Cloud Platform.

• Developed backend API and services of customer engagement and retention squad
• Created shell scripts to automate unit tests, boosting team efficiency.
• Deployed the application to the sandbox and staging servers in Amazon Web Service cloud computing service.
